Description: BNDY Platform Serverless API - Lambda Functions + API Gateway

Properties.Description: JWT signing secret for BNDY API
Properties.Name: bndy/jwt-secret

Properties.Description: BNDY Platform HTTP API
Properties.Name: bndy-api

Properties.Description: BNDY Artists API - handles /api/artists endpoints
BNDY Artist Songs API - handles /api/artist-songs endpoints
BNDY Authentication API - handles OAuth and sessions
BNDY Events API - handles /api/events and /api/calendar endpoints
BNDY Events Agent - AI-powered event discovery
BNDY Flowency Integration - external invites
BNDY Invites API - handles artist/band invitations
BNDY Issues API - handles user-reported issues
BNDY Memberships API - handles artist/band memberships
BNDY Notifications API - handles push notifications
BNDY Setlists API - handles band setlists
BNDY Songs API - handles song library
BNDY Spotify Integration - handles Spotify API
BNDY Uploads API - handles S3 file uploads
BNDY Users API - handles user profiles
BNDY Venues API - handles /api/venues and integration endpoints
BNDY Venue CRM API - handles venue relationship management
BNDY Venue Enrichment - background data enrichment (no HTTP routes)

HttpApiUrl.Description: BNDY HTTP API Gateway endpoint URL
